purpose: Compose the shared app frame and top navigation for public, content, and marketing references.
accessibility: Use the canonical TopNavigation landmark and preserve a logical document heading order.
Keep brand, navigation, actions, and footer links keyboard reachable.
responsive: Wraps top navigation intentionally on narrow viewports.
Uses shared app content geometry and does not introduce a second shell engine.
motion: Uses shared transition tokens for interactive navigation states.
Respects prefers-reduced-motion through the composed primitives.

api.name: brand
api.description: Brand or product mark rendered in the public top navigation.

api.name: navigation
api.description: Canonical top navigation items for the public route.

api.name: children
api.description: Public route content rendered inside the shared app frame.
